title: Indonesia stops a movie about Papua forests

paragraphs: A new movie named Pestabby is causing a big political problem in Indonesia. The movie shows that the government is taking away forests and land from the local people of Papua.

The government wants to build big new farms for rice and sugar. This land is very important to the native people because it is their home and has their holy places. Indonesian soldiers and police stopped people from watching the movie at universities and other places. They say the topic is dangerous. The filmmakers say that the secret police are watching them.

The government doesn’t want international journalists to travel to Papua. But trying to stop the movie made it very famous. Now, many people know about it, and thousands of people are buying tickets to see it.

paragraphs: There is a new movie in Indonesia. Its name is Pestabby. It is a sad story about Papua. The government is cutting down big forests there. The government wants to make big fields for rice and sugar.

But these forests are home to local people. Their holy places are also there. The government does not like this movie. Soldiers go to schools and stop people from watching it. The filmmakers are afraid. Police are watching them.

The government also stops workers from other countries. They cannot go to Papua. But because the government wants to stop the movie, many people now want to see it. Now, all the tickets are gone very quickly.

paragraphs: Indonesian officials are stopping people from watching a new film called Pestabby. The film shows how the government takes land from local people in Papua.

The government wants to clear big forests to build large farms for growing rice and sugar. However, these forests are the home of Indigenous Papuans who depend on them for survival, and their sacred sites are located there. Since the film came out, the filmmakers have faced serious threats, and secret police have been watching them. The military stopped screenings at universities because they said the topic was too sensitive and could cause trouble. Papua remains a politically sensitive topic, and the Indonesian government strictly limits access to the region for international media and human rights groups. But because the government tried to stop the film, it became very famous.
The government’s attempts to ban the documentary have generated massive publicity, which has led to sold-out screenings across the country.
